wingless.purpose: Test source-invariant learned internal state, not a third margin-threshold weighting adjustment

selection_rule.sort: descending development minimum-source accuracy, descending mean-source accuracy, ascending candidate id

falsification.strong: All three frozen independent evaluation blocks gain >=0.05 minimum-source accuracy; candidate overall accuracy >=0.55 and no source harmed by >0.05
falsification.negative: All stronger thresholds unmet; record valid negative without changing candidate or holdout

candidates.hypothesis: An 8-dimensional learned projection jointly trained to predict labels while penalizing source-conditional mean features can reduce source-specific spurious correlations
candidates.mechanism: Train-only 16-to-8-to-16 rank-limited projection, shared across 3 source generators, source discrepancy penalty

candidates.hypothesis: Projecting antagonistic per-source gradients onto their common nonconflicting subspace improves worst-source generalization
candidates.mechanism: Per-epoch train-only gradient conflict surgery before shared 16-dimensional parameter update

candidates.hypothesis: A two-state learned risk consumer that routes training gradients based on source-uncertainty state can improve worst-family accuracy
candidates.mechanism: Frozen-capacity (2 states) train-only source risk gate, 16-dimensional shared linear learner

candidates.hypothesis: A bounded learned memory of hard training examples balanced by source improves representation stability without fixed threshold tuning
candidates.mechanism: Fixed-size 3-source training replay buffer (32 examples/source), learned weights only on development

yggdrasil.purpose: Test earlier onset identification, not just post-detection decoder correction
yggdrasil.control: Pinned Y070 dual-sentinel decoder-corrected policy, fixed public observation schedule

selection_rule.sort: ascending onset pre-detection mismatches, ascending post-detection mismatches, ascending candidate id

falsification.strong: Strict decrease in pre-detection onset mismatch on both frozen legal-pair families, no increase in steady-state mismatch, at most 10 public scalar reads and 7/9 capacity
falsification.negative: Any prereg criterion unmet; record legitimate negative rather than move onset timing

candidates.hypothesis: Training-only optimization of a fixed observation order uses early scalar reads to identify onset before the baseline sentinel order
candidates.mechanism: Learnable permutation of the existing public read schedule; freeze before sealed evaluation

candidates.hypothesis: A bounded retained-state trend predictor prioritizes the sentinel most likely to detect transposition earliest
candidates.mechanism: Fixed state-cardinality trigger learned using development seed history, still 10 public scalars

candidates.hypothesis: Paired coordinate deltas across consecutive observations detect onset earlier than one-step sentinel checks
candidates.mechanism: Two-step stateful onset likelihood under unchanged observation budget

candidates.hypothesis: Sparse learned gate reallocates fixed public reads within a trial for earlier onset identification
candidates.mechanism: Fixed 10-read quota and fixed total 7 active/9 retained, bounded development-trained read allocation
